items.title: Transform any place with Nano Banana in Google Earth
items.content: Custom images — generated from Google Earth satellite, aerial, and 3D imagery — help you redesign any location.
items.contentSnippet: Custom images — generated from Google Earth satellite, aerial, and 3D imagery — help you redesign any location.

summaries.zh: 利用谷歌地球的卫星、航拍和三维图像，Nano Banana 能生成自定义图片，让你可以重新设计任何地点。用户可借助这些由多种地理影像合成的图像，将想象中的改造方案直接呈现在真实场景中，实现创意改造。
summaries.en: Nano Banana is a feature in Google Earth that lets users generate custom images using satellite, aerial, and 3D imagery. This tool allows anyone to visually redesign any location by producing personalized visuals based on existing geographic data.

items.title: How the Head of YouTube Health handles screen time with his kids
items.content: Hear from Dr. Garth Graham on how he sets rules in his own home and helpful approaches for communicating about screen time.
items.contentSnippet: Hear from Dr. Garth Graham on how he sets rules in his own home and helpful approaches for communicating about screen time.

summaries.zh: YouTube健康部门主管加思·格雷厄姆博士分享了自己在家中为孩子制定屏幕使用规则的经验，以及就屏幕时间进行有效沟通的实用方法。他强调了设定明确界限和保持开放对话的重要性，帮助家庭平衡数字生活。
summaries.en: Dr. Garth Graham, head of YouTube Health, shares his personal approach to managing his children's screen time. The article highlights the rules he sets at home and offers communication strategies for parents. He discusses practical ways to navigate screen time conversations with kids, aiming to provide a helpful model for other families.

items.title: Prepare for the holiday season with July’s Demand Gen Drop.
items.content: Prepare for the holiday season with upgraded tROAS bidding, Checkout Links, and more from YouTube’s July Demand Gen Drop.
items.contentSnippet: Prepare for the holiday season with upgraded tROAS bidding, Checkout Links, and more from YouTube’s July Demand Gen Drop.

summaries.zh: YouTube 在七月的需求开发广告更新中推出了多项新功能，旨在帮助广告主提前为假日季做准备。重点包括升级后的目标广告支出回报率（tROAS）自动出价策略，以及可简化购买路径的结账链接等工具。这些更新有助于提升广告投放效率和转化表现。
summaries.en: YouTube’s July Demand Gen Drop introduces tools to help advertisers prepare for the holiday season. Key updates include upgraded tROAS (target return on ad spend) bidding for more efficient campaign optimization and Checkout Links to streamline purchases directly from ads. The release aims to enhance performance and drive sales during the critical shopping period.

items.summary: YouTube 在七月的需求开发广告更新中推出了多项新功能，旨在帮助广告主提前为假日季做准备。重点包括升级后的目标广告支出回报率（tROAS）自动出价策略，以及可简化购买路径的结账链接等工具。这些更新有助于提升广告投放效率和转化表现。

items.title: These Google Trends show people really want to touch grass
items.content: Google Search data reveals a growing desire to unplug and connect in real life with local run clubs, mahjong lessons and more.
items.contentSnippet: Google Search data reveals a growing desire to unplug and connect in real life with local run clubs, mahjong lessons and more.

summaries.en: Google search trends indicate a rising interest in disconnecting from digital life and engaging in real-world social activities. Data shows more people are seeking out local, in-person experiences such as run clubs and mahjong lessons, reflecting a broader desire to "touch grass" and build offline connections.
